answer_1.quote: Video captioning is a challenging cross-modal task that aims to describe videos with natural language sentences.
answer_1.outputs: generated captions (sentences or paragraphs) for videos and images

answer_2.quote: We test the correlation between automatic metrics and human annotation ... We test model-free metrics BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, CIDEr, COAHA, and model-based metrics BERTScore, EM-Score ...

answer_4.quote: To make annotation more reliable, we hire three graduate students as our annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to give three levels of factuality annotation for each video caption: Paragraph-level (Likert scale 1-5 for factuality), Sentence-level (binary label indicating factual errors), and Word-level (marking phrases/words with factual errors).
